verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major test-validity gap. The differential now canonicalizes and compares complete solution multisets, including every projected binding and duplicate multiplicity, while retaining the order-sensitive oracle for ORDER BY. The focused aggregate-value and path-endpoint mutation tests demonstrate that same-cardinality wrong answers are rejected, and the category coverage test confirms that the value oracle actually runs for all applicable generated categories. The deliberate LIMIT/OFFSET and blank-node skips are explicit and consistent with nondeterministic row choice and implementation-defined blank-node labels.
